name: Morgan Nevan
source:
Avril's mentor, a great mage who is rumored to have a very long life.

She is usually lazy, but becomes active when she is interested in something.

[From [Url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/23_Pure/pure_x_hollic.html]official site[/url]]
